name: San Diego Zoo Safari Park
tagline: Elephant Valley first, then a giraffe and Tiger Trail — not the Zoo’s panda path.

practical.ticket_note: Separate ticket from the Zoo; arrive early for parking.
practical.transit_note: Escondido; car-friendly day trip from San Diego.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Safari Park bonus · Elephant Valley + Tiger Trail + Africa field

challenges.text: Elephant Valley: trunk busy or a full rest?
Giraffe: count the spots you can see on one neck.
Tiger Trail: how long until you spot stripes?
Cheetah: statue score 1–10 after 20 quiet seconds.
